author: reek
body: Lattice probe, wrong direction (effect rows stage 0). The prefix relation only widens a child to its parent: Console.Write is covered by Console, and Console is NOT covered by Console.Write. A def that declares the sub-effect and performs the parent must fail with CDX2031.

author: reek
body: The probe needs something whose effect really is the bare parent, and no builtin is one: every console operation is dotted, and print-line-uni declares Console.Write. This test used to call print-line-uni directly and assert its effect was the broader Console. That stopped being true when the builtin was narrowed, and the test then compiled clean -- it had become a probe whose subject satisfied it, proving nothing.

author: reek
body: broad supplies the parent effect honestly: it declares Console and performs Console.Write, which is the permitted direction. narrow then declares the child and performs the parent through broad, which is the direction that must be refused.
